historical_pool_vs_training: Historical pool inclusion is an exclusion-policy signal, not proof every item was generated/evaluated and not proof of current-model training leakage.
formal_data_use: No new formal-test predictions, scores, protection or model-selection use. Existing formal-input files were read only to build content/source exclusion blacklists, and the FLORES archive formal split was accessed only for document-URL metadata.
field_clarification: The frozen translation audit field formal_sentence_text_read=false describes no loading of formal sentence files from the FLORES archive. It must not be read as a statement that no formal-input text was read anywhere: six existing formal-input JSONL files were read for exclusion only. Frozen historical manifest retained unchanged; this clarification corrects the scope of the wording.
effect_on_experiment: Conservative exclusion reduces available confirmation documents. It does not add any supervision or generation, change frozen split membership, metrics, gates or training.
primary_translation_confirmation: Missing; no promotion of old development results to independent confirmation.
